Q: Thank you for agreeing to give this recorded statement. Can you confirm you're comfortable with us recording this
call?
A: Yes, that's fine.
Q: Please describe where the collision happened.
A: It was in a parking lot in Pearland, Texas, at a shopping center. I was pulling out of a parking space near the main
entrance.
Q: What time of day was it, and what were the conditions like?
A: It was in the afternoon. It was dry and bright, so visibility was good.
Q: Walk me through what happened as you were backing out.
A: I checked my mirrors and looked over my shoulder before reversing. I started backing slowly, and when I was
about halfway out, I felt a jolt as another vehicle clipped the rear corner of my car. The other driver was coming down
the aisle, and I didn't see them until the impact.
Q: Did you or the other driver stop before the contact?
A: I had stopped briefly before moving, but the other car didn't appear to slow down much.
Q: Did anyone call for police or exchange information?
A: We exchanged insurance and contact details. I don't believe the police came out, since there were no serious
injuries at the scene.
Q: Tell me about your injuries and when you first noticed them.
A: My lower back felt tight and sore within about an hour. I went to an urgent care clinic later that day, and they
diagnosed a back strain. I've been doing physical therapy and taking it easy with lifting since then.
Q: Are you still experiencing pain, and have you missed any work?
A: Yes, I still have some stiffness, especially after sitting for long periods. I've missed a few days of work and have
been working modified duties for the past couple of weeks.
Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add to your statement?
A: No, I think I've covered everything. Thank you.
Q: Thank you. This concludes the recorded statement.
</page>
